decisions.reason: An online customer portal is low-cost infrastructure that supports the one-stop service model and customer collaboration, so the firm would maintain it.
The award-winning packaging display (Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024) is a showcase innovation the firm will keep promoting.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is a core display format with its own page and fits the established business, though catalog items can be rotated out.
Small counter displays are a standard part of the display portfolio and need few resources to keep offering.
The large freestanding information display fits the broader 3D cardboard strategy, though it may be replaced by newer showcase examples.
